titel: Road Trip File 01 – The Last Ferry
text: Jeremy and Jessica are standing on Liberty Island. It is getting dark, and the {tourists|Touristen} are leaving. “Look at the time!” Jessica says. “The last ferry left ten minutes ago.” ¶ Jeremy checks his phone. “No {signal|Empfang}. Great.” Then he laughs. “Do you remember what the guide said? The statue was a {present|Geschenk} from France in 1886. Maybe France sends us a boat.” ¶ A park {ranger|Parkwächter/in} is walking along the path. She smiles. “You two look {lost|verloren, verirrt},” she says. “I’m closing the gate, but a service boat is going to Manhattan in half an hour. You can come with me – if you help me {carry|tragen} these boxes.” ¶ On the boat, Jessica is looking back at the statue. The torch is {shining|leuchten} against the dark sky. “We missed the ferry,” she says, “but we got the best view of the whole trip.”
